milestone.title: Execute screen overhaul: progress gauge + per-package status

intent.outcome: Execute screen shows a ratatui Gauge for packages completed/total while keeping the existing spinner, per-package result rows, and completion summary.

problem.description: Execute already renders a braille spinner, per-package success/fail rows (group/package + error text), textual n/total progress, and a completion summary (ui/execute.rs). The missing piece is a visual ratatui Gauge driven by completed/total. Spec previously claimed there was no per-package status — that is stale.

in_scope: ratatui Gauge reflecting packages completed vs total (use ExecuteComponent.current/results.len and total).
Keep existing spinner, rows, and completion summary; polish layout under the gauge if needed.
Automated render and/or tui_e2e coverage for gauge/progress.
out_of_scope: Changing the Status screen or StowStatus icon semantics.
Forcing StowStatus icons onto execute rows (different domain: check vs run outcome).

acceptance_criteria.description: Gauge reflects completed/total packages during a run
acceptance_criteria.evidence: make lint ok; cargo test -p andre --test render: 27 passed; cargo test -p andre --test tui_e2e: 6 passed. Gauge completed/total above spinner+rows; completion summary preserved (render + e2e).

acceptance_criteria.description: Each package row still shows icon, name, and result (existing behavior preserved under gauge layout)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: make lint ok; cargo test -p andre --test render: 27 passed; cargo test -p andre --test tui_e2e: 6 passed. Gauge completed/total above spinner+rows; completion summary preserved (render + e2e).

acceptance_criteria.description: Completion summary still shown when finished
acceptance_criteria.evidence: make lint ok; cargo test -p andre --test render: 27 passed; cargo test -p andre --test tui_e2e: 6 passed. Gauge completed/total above spinner+rows; completion summary preserved (render + e2e).

design_decisions.choice: Keep execute-local success/fail icons; do not reuse StowStatus::icon
design_decisions.rationale: StowStatus encodes check-state (stowed/partial/conflict/missing); execute rows encode run outcome. Different domains.

work_packages.name: Progress gauge
work_packages.goal: Add ratatui Gauge for completed/total on Execute.

work_packages.name: Rows + summary under gauge

steps.action: Add ratatui Gauge to execute UI from completed/total; thread current/results into render_execute.
steps.done_when: Gauge renders and ratio matches completed/total in a seeded ExecuteComponent draw.

steps.action: Keep per-package rows (exec success/fail icons — not StowStatus). Adjust layout so rows sit under the gauge without clipping.
steps.done_when: Rows still show icon/name/result alongside gauge; no StowStatus remap required.

steps.action: Confirm completion summary still appears on Finished; extend tui_e2e/render assert if missing.
steps.done_when: Summary assertion exists and suite green.

verification.evidence: make lint ok; cargo test -p andre --test render: 27 passed; cargo test -p andre --test tui_e2e: 6 passed. Gauge completed/total above spinner+rows; completion summary preserved (render + e2e).

findings.description: Progress updates overwrite ExecuteComponent.total with commands-only count from AsyncExecutor, dropping skipped packages from the denominator. With skips, gauge label can show completed>total (e.g. 3/2) after the first Progress event.

viewport_height still uses area.height-2 (borders only) and does not subtract the new 1-row gauge. Scroll page size is one row too large vs list_area, so list scroll/scrollbar desync under the gauge layout.

L1: tui_e2e completion-summary assert is tautological — it rebuilds 'N succeeded, M failed' from the same results vector and compares to a constant, never rendering. Does not verify the Finished UI summary.
Running spinner progress uses results.len()+1 without clamping to total, so after the last Result and before Complete the UI can show (total+1)/total.
Scrollbar content_len still uses results.len()+HEADER_LINES (stale constant 4) instead of the actual items list length after the gauge split; mismatches real list height for Completed/Running.

ExecuteComponent::render passes scroll_index: None when state==Completed, so ListState never selects and long completion result lists cannot scroll. handle_key still updates scroll_index on j/k/PgUp/PgDn, but the UI ignores it — dead scroll path on the Finished screen (AC-02 rows under gauge).
findings.author: external-reviewer

findings.description: Skipped packages are ExecutionResult{success:false, error: Skipped:...}. Completion summary uses failed = len - succeeded, so skips inflate the failed count (e.g. 1 skip → '0 succeeded, 1 failed'). AC-03 summary should distinguish skipped vs failed.
findings.author: external-reviewer
findings.summary: Completion summary counts skips as failed

findings.description: Running UI shows 'Press Ctrl+C to cancel' but (1) Confirm discards AsyncExecutor immediately so AbortHandle is gone, (2) ExecuteComponent never handles Ctrl+C. Misleading chrome on the M03 execute screen. Prefer removing the dead hint over async model changes (out of scope).
findings.author: external-reviewer
findings.fixed_in: execute: drop dead Ctrl+C cancel hint

findings.description: test_execute_screen_shows_pending pushes a Running ExecuteComponent and asserts 'Executing' — name claims Pending. Rename or seed Pending state.
findings.author: external-reviewer
